title: Stress and Meter
subtitle: Iambic pentameter — five beats, alternating stress.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Chaucer writes iambic pentameter. Five beats per line, alternating unstressed and stressed. The final -e counts as a syllable when you need ten syllables; drops when you have ten without it. Scan the line to know when to pronounce it. Meter is the key.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Stress and Meter.
